meta.name: core-web-vitals
meta.description: Optimize Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) for better page experience using field and lab evidence. Use when asked to "improve Core Web Vitals", "fix LCP", "reduce CLS", "optimize INP", "page experience optimization", or "fix layout shifts".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用真实数据诊断并优化网页性能,让浏览更流畅
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的网站加载慢,想用数据找出并解决性能瓶颈
copy.tagline_en: Make your web pages load faster and feel more responsive using real user data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your site is slow and you want to fix it using real user data

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会针对 LCP、INP、CLS 三个网页性能指标给出优化建议,包括代码修复示例、检查清单和调试脚本,并说明如何用实验室与真实数据测量定位问题。
howto.when: 当用户提出“improve Core Web Vitals”“fix LCP”“reduce CLS”等请求,或要求做页面体验优化、修复布局偏移时触发。

say.text: 帮我优化 LCP,首屏图片加载太慢了。
say.note: Claude 会定位 LCP 元素并给出预加载、压缩等修复。

say.text: 降低页面 CLS,图片加载时不要跳动。
优化 INP,点击按钮后响应很卡。

howto.what_en: Installing this skill makes Claude give targeted optimization advice for LCP, INP, and CLS, including code fixes, checklists, debugging snippets, and measurement guidance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to improve Core Web Vitals, fix LCP, reduce CLS, optimize INP, or mentions page experience optimization or layout shifts.

say_en.text: Help me optimize LCP, the hero image loads too slowly.
say_en.note: Claude identifies the LCP element and suggests preloading or compression.

say_en.text: Reduce CLS so images don't shift when loading.
say_en.note: Claude suggests setting width/height or aspect-ratio on images.

say_en.text: Optimize INP, clicks on buttons feel laggy.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes long tasks and suggests chunking or scheduler.yield.
